name: chart-pie-02
title: chart-pie-02
description: Acquisition breakdown · June 2026. Organic search accounts for 42% of all visits.

meta.prompt:
Create a responsive analytics card titled “How visitors find you” with the muted eyebrow “Acquisition breakdown · June 2026”. Fill available width up to 576px. Use a theme-aware card surface, rounded border, an 18px title, a prominent 30px semibold metric with tabular numerals, and a separated muted footer.

Show a donut with a 68px inner radius, 95px outer radius, 3-degree gaps, and subtle slice outlines. Represent Organic 420, Direct 280, Referral 180, and Social 120 with four theme chart colors. Leave the center empty. Include a color legend and tooltips, a 1,000 visits headline, and a footer explaining organic search accounts for 42% of visits.

Keep the plot 260px tall and responsive to the card width. Provide accessible chart navigation and value tooltips.

Build the chart with TanStack Charts. Use responsive chart geometry, theme-aware chart colors, a labeled legend, and pointer and keyboard value tooltips.
